versions.changelog:
Initial release of 特殊特性识别技能 (special-characteristic-manager).

- Enables extraction and identification of product/process special characteristics (CC/SC) from diverse, unstructured materials (images, specs, emails, Excel, verbal).
- Supports symbol translation, classification, material gap indication, and generates pure text characteristic lists and transmission matrices tailored for APQP scenarios.
- Requires explicit user confirmation of report outline before generating the final Markdown report.
- Clearly defines skill boundaries and mandatory rules for usage.
- Adapts to various material formats, with clear handling instructions for each.
